Name: dizzi Portrait Style Switcher
Author: dizziRD
Description:
[b]Portrait style selector for Content Patcher. No artwork included.[/b]

Adds a per-NPC, per-style toggle to the portraits you already have installed.
Every style is loaded from the portrait mod that provides it. This pack contains
no images - not a single portrait, sprite or icon - so every portrait you see
comes from an author whose mod is already on your machine.

11 styles across the vanilla cast plus expansion villagers: Pretty, Beautiful,
OO's, Dacar, Lannah, Rasmodia, FadeHeim, Buxom, Skimpy Bachelor, Felicia, Kent
Girl and Vanilla. Also covers SVE and the random social NPCs (Dwarf, Gil,
Gunther).

The portraits this pack points to belong to their respective authors and remain
theirs. This pack only decides which installed mod wins the load order for each
NPC, using Content Patcher's own Priority and Conditions. No artwork is modified,
converted, recoloured or redistributed here.

Why the portrait authors don't ship this themselves: a usable style switcher has
to reference the internal asset paths of every competing portrait mod, including
their competitors' mods, and each author would have to keep that list current as
everyone updates. None of them will. Load order is nobody's job.

[b]Requires- Content Patcher 2.3.0 or newer[/b]

- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC) 0.7.5 or newer
- DDFC Scaler 2.0.0 or newer

Optional - only needed for the styles you actually use
- Pretty Anime Portraits / Pretty Anime Genderbends (SerDakota)
- Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 (TheMud)
- OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits, and its SVE edition (TwoCircles)
- Dacar's portrait packs (DacarTheGorilla)
- Lannah - Female Lance (Nom0ri)
- FadeHeim's Rasmodia and East Scarp anime style portrait (FadeHeim)
- kent girl (ZEROp1xe1)
- Stardew Valley Expanded (FlashShifter)
- East Scarp (LemurKat) - for Aideen

If a style's source mod is not installed, that style simply won't be selectable.
Nothing else is affected.

Optional adult content. Safe to skip if you don't want it.
